name: Guernsey
summary_text: Guernsey: Crown Dependency, own parliament and equality law covering gender identity; the UK EHRC single-sex code does not extend here. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of +0.12. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not Guernsey; included as UK-context material (Guernsey is a Crown Dependency).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not Guernsey; included as UK-context material only.
Guernsey Billet d'État (24 June 2015): official States of Guernsey legislative business document - includes the review of Adoption Law (p.1170) that led to same-sex couples' adoption rights.

sources.title: Same-sex marriage gets Guernsey States approval - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (Dec 2015): Guernsey's States approved same-sex marriage 37-7, rejecting civil-partnership and single 'Union Civile' alternatives; legislation expected no earlier than 2017 - described by charity Liberate as 'an historic day'.

sources.title: Guernsey law change allows same-sex couples to adopt - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (June 2015): Guernsey law change allows same-sex couples to adopt - the 50-year-old Adoption Law had banned all unmarried couples from adopting; new law recognises civil partnerships and gives equal parental responsibility.

sources.title: Guernsey to follow relaxation of UK blood donor rules - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (Sept 2011): Guernsey to follow the UK's relaxation of blood-donor rules, allowing gay and bisexual men to donate after a 12-month deferral - ending the 1980s HIV-era ban.
